<thought>Using the mass‑spectrometry data, the most intense peak is at m/z 194.086 Da. Assuming this corresponds to the molecular ion (M⁺), the neutral monoisotopic mass is ≈ 194.086 Da. The formula that best matches this mass is C₁₁H₁₄O₃ (exact mass 194.094 Da, within typical experimental tolerance). Therefore the molecular formula is C11H14O3.</thought>
<final_answer>C11H14O3</final_answer>
